author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
The air is filled with the fragrance of blooming roses as harvest season arrives 🌹🌿 In this video, we gather fresh rose petals and turn them into traditional homemade rose sweets using simple methods passed down through generations.

The petals are carefully prepared to preserve their delicate aroma and natural beauty, creating a sweet treat with a unique floral flavor. Every step reflects the patience and craftsmanship of old village traditions.

This is a timeless way of preserving the beauty of the rose harvest — simple ingredients, gentle preparation, and authentic homemade charm. A sweet village tradition that captures the essence of summer in every bite. 🌹🍬✨
title: Rose Harvest Season – Making Traditional Rose Sweets ...🌹
